name: Black Friday -  L3ftov3rs
intro: It's been 5 years since we did our first thxgiving and Black Friday 3v3nt.   And, we're celebrating with a mini chase that leads us through Cyb3r Monday.
If you participate in all 3 phases of the 3v3nt, you'll recieve the Cyb3r Monday Chase Award.

First phase - L3ftov3rs.   Who still has leftovers from the 2021 thxgiving?   The 100 Gourd Pie cost 20tz back then and its turned into literally thousands of orange inserts and a ton of base card and limited edition inserts.  Still have one lying around?   Let's see it!  And, you can claim the first L3ftov3rs edition for yourself.
No Pie?   You can burn the free thxgiving insert Turkey Carver 1:1 for the new edition.
Same goes for thr33zi3s traits... hold a 100 Gourd Pie trait and you get one edition.  Or, burn your Turkey Carver trait (fork/knife or turkey) to get one edition.
Hey, there may even be some hidden secret Ingredients.
No limit on editions claimed.  but, you need 1 to be a part of the chase.
If you do not have any qualifying paintings, or if you don't want to burn, you can purchase ONE edition for $25USD.
Phases 2 and 3 will be open for 12 hours each and will randomly drop between now and 11:59pm Monday, so keep your notifications one!
